name: Cyclone Sire — "If you do, that land becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature" animates only the target land
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (pronoun-subject clusters). The fired-ability text now drops 'If you do,' and converts 'that land becomes' to 'target land becomes'; the becomes parser trims a cross-sentence subject that starts with plain 'target'. Before, nothing was produced; mid-fix it was global (every land).

call: you may put three +1/+1 counters on target land you control. If you do, that land becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land.
When this creature dies, you may put three +1/+1 counters on target land you control. If you do, that land becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land.
